title: Q-CONNECT-3: per-tenant connect buttons and a token interface for tenant tools
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** driver order
**Done check:** grep:dashboard/worker.js::Q-CONNECT-3-DONE
**Status:** open

Successor of OL-20261114-2. The dashboard Connections panel reads the runtime's own tenant from the tick Worker /auth/connectors. Remaining: the tick Worker accepts a tenant id on /auth/connectors, the panel lists every tenant with a connect link per provider, and tenant tools get a token through one audited interface instead of a binding. Mark the route with the comment Q-CONNECT-3-DONE when its tests pass.
